description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to the Ocdm component within the Rialto media server. It includes class declarations for OcdmFactory and Ocdm, with methods for obtaining Ocdm instances and checking support for key system types.

classes.name: OcdmFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing Ocdm instances, including singleton management.

classes.name: Ocdm
classes.description: Implementation of the IOcdm interface, representing the Ocdm component with support checking functionality.

methods.name: OcdmFactory::getOcdm
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to an IOcdm instance, creating or retrieving the singleton.

methods.name: Ocdm::isTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given key system type is supported by this Ocdm instance.
